response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent communication skills, he lacks the critical technical domain expertise required for this role. The position requires deep Java/Kotlin knowledge, Spring ecosystem expertise, and JVM platform understanding. His career has focused on full-stack web development with TypeScript/Node.js, with minimal (2014-2018) and outdated Java experience and no Kotlin mentioned. Despite being a capable engineer at the right seniority level, the technical alignment gap is too significant.
strengths: Strong staff-level seniority with proven ability to architect complex systems handling millions of transactions per second (Dunnhumby)
Excellent communication and collaboration skills demonstrated through workshops, public talks, and active open source community contributions
Solid software craftsmanship foundation with emphasis on testing, clean architecture, and extensible design patterns
concerns: Minimal and outdated Java experience (last Java work 2014-2018) with no Kotlin knowledge, both critical requirements for the role
Complete absence of Spring ecosystem and enterprise framework experience (Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate) explicitly listed as required
Primary technology stack is TypeScript/Node.js web development, creating a fundamental platform mismatch with JVM-focused role requirements
